customManagers.description: Keep the alpine/k8s hook toolbox tag+digest in sync wherever it is pinned (chart annotation and template defaults)
Keep the Makefile golangci-lint pin in sync with the version the CI workflow uses. Without this, Renovate bumps only the workflow and `make lint` silently diverges from CI.

Track name:tag@sha256 image pins that no built-in manager reads: chainsaw manifests and the chainsaw preload list, the quickstart sample, examples, docs snippets, scripts and the kind node image in the composite actions. Dockerfiles, compose files and chart templates are left to their own managers so nothing is tracked twice.
Track the kind release helm/kind-action installs, so it moves together with the pinned kindest/node image
Track the controller-gen pin in the Makefile; the kubernetes ecosystem group moves it with the k8s.io modules
Track the setup-envtest pin in the Makefile; the kubernetes ecosystem group moves it with controller-runtime
Track the client-gen/applyconfiguration-gen pin in the Makefile so the generated clientset follows the k8s.io modules it is built against
Track the chainsaw pin in the Makefile and the checksum-verified chainsaw install in the chainsaw workflow
Track the oras CLI version setup-oras installs in the release workflow
Track the cosign release cosign-installer installs in the release workflow; the version lives in a workflow env var, which the github-actions manager does not read
Track the helm release the install-helm composite action downloads and checksums; every workflow installs helm through it
Track CI tools installed with pipx at a pinned version (semgrep, zizmor); the github-actions manager does not read run steps

Track Go CI tools run or installed at a pinned version in workflows (gosec, govulncheck, actionlint). The capture is the module path, keeping a /vN major suffix, because Go resolves versions per module, not per package

packageRules.description: Group all non-major Go module updates

Hold structured-merge-diff below v7. A Go major is a module path rename, and every k8s.io module at v0.37.0 still compiles managedfields against v6, so v7 cannot build. Drop the rule when k8s.io/apimachinery moves to v7; v6.x patches keep flowing meanwhile.

Group GitHub Actions updates, and hold each new release for 7 days. SHA pins stop a retagged release from running here; the cooldown stops Renovate from proposing a freshly published malicious one (the tj-actions/changed-files compromise lasted three days)
Dockerfile base image — security-sensitive, label clearly
Group the pinned images in tests, docs, examples and scripts into one PR instead of one per image
Hold busybox on the 1.36 line: busybox.net still marks 1.37 and 1.38 unstable. Raise the bound when it calls a newer release stable.
Keep every alpine/k8s pin (chart hook and the chainsaw preload list) in one PR, labelled as a container image
kind supports only the node image digests listed in its release notes, so the kind release and the kindest/node pin arrive in one PR; check the digest against those notes before merging
The chainsaw workflow installs chainsaw only when the tarball matches the sha256 sums pinned next to the version; a bump fails CI until those sums are updated in the same PR

The install-helm action installs helm only when the tarball matches the sha256 sums pinned next to the version; a bump fails CI until those sums are updated in the same PR, from the .sha256sum files on get.helm.sh
Skip helm v4.2.1 only: an intermittent WaitForDelete race affecting before-hook-creation hooks (upstream helm#32214), reverted in v4.2.2 (commit b05881c). v4.2.2+ is allowed by this range.

The Go version also lives in the Dockerfile, the Makefile lint pin and the docs, and golangci-lint must be built with it first. Bump the directive deliberately via the dashboard; patch bumps stay automatic.
Group the CI tools pinned in workflow run steps, with the same 7-day cooldown as the actions that run them
